Let me propose.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_64caDQiDJMc9dlSKdgX06075","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { parseBearer, jwtVerify } from \"zttp:auth\";\nimport { env } from \"zttp:env\";\n\nstructural AuthProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"fault_covered\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): AuthProof<Response> {\n  const authorization = req.headers.get(\"Authorization\");\n  if (authorization === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"unauthorized\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  const token = parseBearer(authorization);\n  if (token === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"unauthorized\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  const secret = env(\"JWT_SECRET\");\n  if (secret === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"unauthorized\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  const verified = jwtVerify(token, secret);\n  if (!verified.ok) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"unauthorized\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  return Response.json({ authenticated: true });\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":25778,"completion_tokens":622,"total_tokens":26400,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":25600},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":175},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":25600,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":178},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
